title: Compose verify block (COMP-VERIFY-FLOW-1)
description: The optional `verify` block of `.compose/compose.json`. A project declares user flows: a command that starts the app, drives it the way a user does, prints what it saw, and cleans up. Compose runs the flows a change touches before a feature becomes COMPLETE (lib/completion-gate.js) and on demand (`compose verify`). A flow PASSes when it exits 0 AND every `expect` line appears in its stdout (lib/verify-flows.js judgeRun). No `verify` block means no flow ever runs.

id.description: Unique within the block. Names the flow in output, logs and refusal codes.

command.description: argv array, run with the workspace root as cwd, in its own process group (same shape as guard.testCommand). Never a shell string.

covers.description: Repo-relative path globs (`*` one segment, `**` any depth, `?` one character). A completion whose changed files match any glob runs this flow.

expect.description: Literal lines that must each appear in stdout as a whole line (compared after trimming surrounding whitespace). They are the answer; the exit code alone never passes a flow.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the flow's whole process group is killed and the run refused FLOW_TIMEOUT. Default 600.

setup_exit_codes.description: Exit codes meaning the flow could not start (a missing tool, a port it could not get), reported FLOW_SETUP_ERROR rather than FLOW_FAILED. Default [127]. A spawn error (command not found) is always a setup error.
